whatItDoes.text: Apple designs, makes and sells smartphones, computers, tablets, wearables, accessories and related services.
whatItDoes.quote: The Company designs, manufactures and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and sells a variety of related services.

howItMakesMoney.text: It earns revenue from selling hardware and from fee‑based services such as AppleCare.
howItMakesMoney.quote: The Company offers a portfolio of fee‑based service and support products under the AppleCare® brand.

competitiveEdge.text: Apple says its edge comes from designing and developing almost the entire product solution, from hardware to software and services.
competitiveEdge.quote: The Company designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services.

biggestRisks.text: Reliance on single‑source components creates significant supply and pricing risk.
biggestRisks.quote: Because the Company currently obtains certain components from single or limited sources, the Company is subject to significant supply and pricing risks.

biggestRisks.text: Success depends on protecting its intellectual property against infringement.
biggestRisks.quote: The Company’s ability to compete successfully also depends on the effective protection and enforcement of its intellectual property rights.

dropped.text: Apple states it holds only a minority share of the global smartphone, PC, tablet and wearables markets.
The company notes ongoing supply constraints and rising component costs due to industry‑wide supply‑demand imbalances.
Service revenue growth is driven by higher sales of advertising, the App Store and cloud services.
Adverse macroeconomic conditions could reduce consumer confidence and spending.
Apple expects its cash and marketable securities to cover cash needs and its capital return program for at least the next year.
In Q3 2026 Apple announced iOS 27, macOS 27 Golden Gate, iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, visionOS 27, tvOS 27 and introduced Siri AI.
